name: Temporal Gradient
algorithm: Temporal Gradient — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes temporal gradient patterns for video deepfake detection:

1. **时间梯度计算**: The frame-to-frame difference (temporal gradient) I_t(x,y) = I(x,y,t+1) − I(x,y,t) is computed for each pixel. This captures the instantaneous rate of change of image intensity over time.

2. **时间梯度Statistics**: The distribution of temporal gradient values is analyzed. Natural video shows specific gradient distributions: approximately Laplacian with width depending on motion speed. The method detects anomalous gradient distributions — too narrow (overly stable, suggesting generated smoothing) or too wide (excessive temporal variation).

3. **空间-时间梯度Relationship**: The relationship between spatial gradients (edges) and temporal gradients (motion) should follow the optical flow constraint equation: I_x·u + I_y·v + I_t = 0. The method checks this constraint. Generated video may violate the brightness constancy assumption in ways inconsistent with any physical motion.

4. **人脸-Background梯度比较**: Temporal gradient statistics of face and background regions are compared. In authentic video from a single camera, both show similar temporal noise characteristics. Deepfakes may show different temporal gradient statistics in the face (from the generation process) compared to the background (from the camera).

5. **时间梯度Map分析**: A map of temporal gradient magnitude reveals which regions change most between frames. In authentic video, high-gradient regions correspond to moving objects and edges. Deepfake artifacts may produce elevated temporal gradients at face boundaries, blending zones, or throughout the generated face due to per-frame rendering inconsistency.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through temporal gradient analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow based CNN. ICCV Workshop.
